title: lianapy
description: Performs LIANA integration based as described in https://github.com/saezlab/liana-py

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `input.h5mu`

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `output.h5mu`

modality.description: Which modality from the input MuData file to process.

layer.description: Layer in anndata.AnnData.layers to use. If None, use mudata.mod[modality].X.

de_method.description: Differential expression method. `scanpy.tl.rank_genes_groups` is used to rank genes according to 1vsRest.

groupby.description: The key of the observations grouping to consider.

resource_name.description: Name of the resource to be loaded and use for ligand-receptor inference.

gene_symbol.description: Column name in var DataFrame in which gene symbol are stored.

expr_prop.description: Minimum expression proportion for the ligands/receptors (and their subunits) in the corresponding cell identities. Set to '0', to return unfiltered results.

min_cells.description: Minimum cells per cell identity ('groupby') to be considered for downstream analysis.

aggregate_method.description: Method aggregation approach, one of ['mean', 'rra'], where 'mean' represents the mean rank, while 'rra' is the RobustRankAggregate (Kolde et al., 2014) of the interactions.

consensus_opts.description: Strategies to aggregate interactions across methods. Default is None - i.e. ['Specificity', 'Magnitude'] and both specificity and magnitude are aggregated.

return_all_lrs.description: Bool whether to return all LRs, or only those that surpass the 'expr_prop' threshold. Those interactions that do not pass the 'expr_prop' threshold will be assigned to the *worst* score of the ones that do. 'False' by default.

n_perms.description: Number of permutations for the permutation test. Note that this is relevant only for permutation-based methods - e.g. 'CellPhoneDB

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
